title: Uniform L1 distortion of planar graph metrics
exact_target: Is there one finite C such that every finite connected planar graph with arbitrary positive real edge lengths has a map f into a real $L^{1}$ space and a scale $s>0$ satisfying $s\cdot d(x,y)\leq \Vert f(x)-f(y)\Vert _{1}\leq C\cdot s\cdot d(x,y)$ for all vertices, where d is weighted shortest-path distance?
